text: At its meeting on November 24, 2020, the Board of Health - Performance Appraisal of the Medical Officer of Health Committee considered Item HP3.1, 2019 Performance Appraisal - Medical Officer of Health.

The Board of Health: 1. Approved the Confidential Recommendation from the Board of Health - Performance Appraisal of the Medical Officer of Health Committee in Confidential Attachment 1 to the letter (November 24, 2020) from the Board of Health - Performance Appraisal of the Medical Officer of Health Committee. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the letter (November 24, 2020) from the Board of Health - Performance Appraisal of the Medical Officer of Health Committee and Confidential Attachment 2 from the Medical Officer of Health remain confidential, as they relate to personal matters about an identifiable individual, including a municipal or local board employee.
